name: bug
description: Reproducible defect in code, data, schema, or proof

name: error
description: Factual, numerical, citation, or build error

name: issue
description: Operational, licensing, workflow, or usability issue

name: problem
description: Structural or architectural flaw requiring redesign

name: concern
description: Epistemic, methodological, security, or quality concern

name: dilemma
description: Genuine design or scope trade-off with competing criteria

name: conflict
description: Contradiction between documents, rules, or assertions

name: gap
description: Missing coverage, test, standard item, or documentation

name: hole
description: Unchecked boundary, missing edge case, or verification hole

name: blindspot
description: Unexamined assumption, hidden bias, or overlooked failure mode
